package.name: aav_watchdog_rs
package.description: The sensor watchdog in Rust (rclrs): the default since 16 Nov (Ben), in place of aav_safety's Python sensor_watchdog (removed 20 Nov). The same node name, topics, QoS, parameters and answers: each input's topic in; /safety/sensor_watchdog/lock, /safety/sensor_watchdog/state and /diagnostics out; the clear service. A safety lock; the Python is one switch away (watchdog_impl:=python). The logic is the watchdog-core crate, with no ROS, checked tick by tick against the Python node's answers.
